item.title: The Philippines Unveils First National Digital Connectivity Plan
item.description: The Philippines officially launches its first National Digital Connectivity Plan to expand fast, secure and affordable internet nationwide, bridging the digital divide and empowering all Filipino citizens fully by 2028.

item.title: Singapore Launches National AI R&D Plan for Public Good
item.description: Singapore has unveiled a S$1 billion National AI R&D Plan to strengthen fundamental and applied AI research, foster talent development and promote innovative solutions that benefit society locally and globally.

item.title: Indonesia Strengthens Child Protection and Digital Resilience
item.description: Indonesia is proactively safeguarding children in the digital age through education, digital literacy and community collaboration to foster resilience, empathy, social harmony and responsible online behaviour.

item.title: Singapore Commits S$1 Billion to Boost National AI Research Capabilities
item.description: Singapore will invest over SG$1 billion from 2025 to 2030 under the NAIRD Plan to strengthen AI research, develop local and global talent, foster innovation and reinforce its position as a global AI hub.

item.title: Malaysia: Computing Gains Momentum with Penang Centre
item.description: A new Penang-based engineering centre expands embedded and edge computing R&D, accelerating regional innovation, platform development and time-to-market across Asia-Pacific.

item.title: Australia: NSW Launches Streamlined AI Assessment Framework
item.description: The New South Wales government has launched a redesigned AI Assessment Framework to streamline risk-based governance, align with global standards and accelerate the responsible adoption of AI across public sector agencies.

item.title: India Advances Indigenous Semiconductor Design Ecosystem
item.description: India is strengthening its indigenous semiconductor design ecosystem through the Design Linked Incentive Scheme, fostering startups and academic innovation to boost self-reliance and competitiveness.

item.title: HKUST Partners to Accelerate Technology-Enabled Clinical Research
item.description: HKUST has signed strategic MoUs with three Zhejiang University hospitals to advance AI-driven medical research, clinical innovation and interdisciplinary technology-enabled healthcare education.

item.title: Vietnam: First Crypto Exchange to Boost Digital Asset Ecosystem
item.description: Vietnam’s launch of crypto exchange licensing aims to boost foreign investment, significantly enhance overall market transparency and strengthen effective regulatory oversight in the country’s digital asset sector.

item.title: Singapore: New Hardware Testbed Advances Quantum Capabilities
item.description: A quantum-innovation company has launched a new quantum hardware testbed, strengthening its national ecosystem, global collaborations and talent development in advanced quantum technologies.
